items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Oh, Economy Hall, well Kid Aria and Yurica Band, all bands.

ctx.x: Well you didn't tell me who was at the Economy Hall.

Oh, Economy Hall, well Kid Aria and Yurica Band, all bands. They did different clubs would give it, they'd have different bands. They didn't have no special bands. Same way with the Economy Hall, same way. See, we had the Economy Hall and what's that? Co-operators. Co-operators, yeah. And then we had this Franz Amir, the Franz Amir Hall. That's the whole way nobody ducked like me and you couldn't go in there. Creoles. Creoles, yeah.
Well I think that's about the end of the tape here, so we'll put the ladies to talk in the next pace. Oh, I don't talk now. You talked now? We're speaking.
